pr.title: Simplify collection helper
pr.body: collect(item, items=None): append to the provided list, or a fresh list if omitted; return a copy.

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def collect(item, items=None):
     if items is None:
-        items = []
+        items = list()
     items.append(item)
-    return items[:]
+    return list(items)

findings.description: The changes to the return statement of the `collect` function cause an `AttributeError` when an existing list is passed as an argument, breaking the expected behavior.

input.body: The changes introduced in this PR lead to an `AttributeError` when attempting to use an existing list as an argument for the `collect` function. This is due to the modification of the return statement from returning a copy of the list to returning a new list, which does not maintain the reference to the original list. This change breaks the expected behavior of the function when an existing list is provided.
